title: Advance Wars 2: Black Hole Rising
subtitle: The allied armies face another invasion
summary: Advance Wars 2: Black Hole Rising is Intelligent Systems' Game Boy Advance strategy sequel following the Allied Nations against a renewed Black Hole invasion. Its battlefields retain the readable arrangement of towns, factories and military units, with each side taking turns to move and attack. New commanding officers and campaign situations expand the established rules. The conflict now spreads across several countries, giving the player different armies and responsibilities as the invasion develops. Winning still depends on understanding the local map, preserving useful units and turning captured resources into the force needed for the next objective.
body: Advance Wars 2: Black Hole Rising is Intelligent Systems' Game Boy Advance strategy sequel following the Allied Nations against a renewed Black Hole invasion. Its battlefields retain the readable arrangement of towns, factories and military units, with each side taking turns to move and attack. New commanding officers and campaign situations expand the established rules. The conflict now spreads across several countries, giving the player different armies and responsibilities as the invasion develops. Winning still depends on understanding the local map, preserving useful units and turning captured resources into the force needed for the next objective.

Commanding officers bring different strengths to an army, affecting how particular units perform and what can happen when their special powers become available. Black Hole Rising adds stronger Super CO Powers, giving a player another decision about whether to use the available charge immediately or save it for a larger effect. The choice is tied to the current battlefield. An ordinary advantage may be enough to keep a position, while waiting can prepare the turn that finally breaks a defensive line or makes a difficult attack practical for several units at once.

The campaign allows a selection of missions within its different national theatres rather than following only one fixed sequence. Completing requirements opens further operations and moves the wider conflict forward. War Room maps offer separate tactical challenges, and Versus supports contests on existing or player-created battlefields. These arrangements give the same clear rules different purposes. The campaign develops its armies through an invasion story, while another mode can concentrate on a single difficult starting position or the challenge of reading a human opponent's intentions across the next contested section of the map.
